fusions.name: Barbed Heel
fusions.desc: A heel strike that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrashing Snag
fusions.desc: You thrash in place, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Dragged at the Tail
fusions.desc: Snags up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles and pulls them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Can't Follow
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
